name: kikin
description: Check available funding, review loans and see upcoming repayments from your Kikin account.

interface.longDescription:
Pay suppliers faster, access working capital and extend your runway with Kikin.

Connect your Kikin account to ChatGPT to get answers about your business funding, right where you're already working. Ask questions in your own words to see how much funding you have available, keep track of your financed invoices and working capital loans, and find out what's due next and when.

Get a clear view of your funding and repayments, so you can plan ahead and focus on growing your business.
defaultPrompt: How much funding do we have available?
What repayments are coming up, and how much will they total?
Show our latest loans and what they financed.
